page.layout: One column of running text in the centre, with a decorative woodcut ornament and title block above it. Margin notes in the right margin: "Livia." beside the line "Sanctitate domus", and "Fortuna in-fra homi-nem." beside the lines "Romulum vigilantia".

main_text.head: QUINTUS ANNALIUM TACITI liber per Aphorismos explicatus.
Suum cuique decus posteritas rependit.
main_text.p: CREMUTII Cordi extrema verba sunt: IV. Annalium. Multorum oculos aut livor, aut potentiae admiratio perstrinxit: qui defunctorum bona vel mala, detracta externorum larva, acutius intuentur. Livia, quam Juliam Augustam adoptiva acclamatio appellat, post Tiberium Neronem Augusto imperatori nupta, sermones de se & candida hominum judicia coercuit. Post fata domum, exuta fortunae blandientis toga, sua dote apparuit. Sanctitate domus priscum ad morem, castis[?] ultra quam Livia.antiquum foeminis probatum, mater impotens, uxor facilis, & cum artibus mariti, simulatione filii bene composita. Non eam quicquam auri & gemmarum, non aulae potentia in sepulcrum sequitur: sequitur morum rectitudo; nec, si qua fuit, pravitas abscondITUR. Ab animo fortuna, non a fortuna hominis animus dignitatem foeneratur. Nemo priscorum regum, aut infequentium in populari statu ducum, ab opulentia posteritati commendatur. Romulum vigilantia, Numam Pompilium religio, Tullum Hostilium alacritas,Fortuna in-fra homi-nem.

page.notes: The word "castis" is doubtful: the scan reads "ca mis", so it is marked [?]. "abscondITUR" is printed in mixed capitals in the scan; I have copied it as "abscondITUR" but it may be a printing error for "abscondiтyp" or "abscond itur". The line ending "alacritas," is the last line on the page and continues on the next page. The woodcut "C" is joined to "REMUTII" as "CREMUTII". The page number 365 is printed at the top. The margin note "Fortuna in-fra homi-nem." is hyphenated across its lines as printed.
